Title: Register with email and password
Body: As a new user, I want to create an account with my email and password so that I can use GearGuardian.

Title: Verify email address
Body: As a newly registered user, I want to verify my email address so that my account is activated securely.

Title: Resend verification email
Body: As a user, I want to request another verification email if the previous one expired or did not arrive.

Title: Sign in with email and password
Body: As a verified user, I want to sign in with my email and password so that I can access my groups and checklists.

Title: Sign in with SSO
Body: As a user, I want to sign in with a supported SSO provider so that I can access GearGuardian without another password.

Title: Connect SSO to an existing account
Body: As a signed-in user, I want to connect an SSO provider to my existing account so that both sign-in methods use the same data.

Title: Resolve an existing account during SSO sign-in
Body: As a user whose SSO email matches an existing account, I want guidance for securely linking the accounts instead of creating a duplicate.

Title: Request a password reset
Body: As a user who forgot my password, I want to request a reset link by email so that I can recover access.

Title: Set a new password
Body: As a user with a valid reset link, I want to set a new password so that I can sign in again.

Title: Manage connected sign-in methods
Body: As a user, I want to see and manage my connected sign-in methods so that I understand how I can access my account.

Title: Sign out from the current device
Body: As a signed-in user, I want to sign out securely from the current device.

Title: Create a sport profile
Body: As an athlete, I want to create a profile for a sport so that my equipment can be organized by activity.

Title: Choose an activity type
Body: As an athlete, I want to distinguish training, competition, casual play, and travel so that the checklist fits the event.

Title: Create a personal equipment checklist
Body: As an athlete, I want to create a personal equipment checklist so that I do not forget essential items.

Title: Add a custom equipment item
Body: As an athlete, I want to add equipment that is not in the default suggestions.

Title: Edit an equipment item
Body: As an athlete, I want to change an item's name, quantity, category, or importance.

Title: Remove an equipment item
Body: As an athlete, I want to remove an item that is no longer needed.

Title: Mark an item as mandatory
Body: As an athlete, I want to mark an item as mandatory so that I am warned before leaving without it.

Title: Save a reusable checklist
Body: As an athlete, I want to save a checklist as a reusable template for future sessions.

Title: Duplicate a checklist
Body: As an athlete, I want to duplicate a checklist so that I can adapt it without starting from scratch.

Title: Create a group
Body: As an athlete, I want to create a team or activity group so that members can coordinate equipment.

Title: Join a group using a shareable link
Body: As an invited athlete, I want to join a group through a link so that joining is quick.

Title: Join a group using a QR code
Body: As an invited athlete, I want to scan a QR code and join the correct group.

Title: Review a group invitation before joining
Body: As an invited athlete, I want to see the group name, activity, and member count before accepting.

Title: Leave a group
Body: As a member, I want to leave a group I no longer participate in.

Title: View group members
Body: As a group member, I want to see who belongs to the group.

Title: Remove a group member
Body: As a group owner or admin, I want to remove a member who should no longer have access.

Title: Regenerate a group invitation
Body: As a group owner, I want to invalidate an old invitation and create a new one.

Title: Add a shared equipment item
Body: As a group member, I want to add equipment that one or several people need to bring for the group.

Title: Set a required quantity for a shared item
Body: As a group member, I want to define how many units are required so that coverage is clear.

Title: Claim responsibility for a shared item
Body: As a group member, I want to announce that I will bring a shared item.

Title: Claim part of a required quantity
Body: As a group member, I want to cover part of the required quantity so that several people can share responsibility.

Title: See who is bringing each shared item
Body: As a group member, I want to see who is responsible for each item and quantity so that we avoid duplicates and gaps.

Title: Mark a shared item as packed
Body: As a responsible member, I want to confirm that my assigned item has actually been packed.

Title: Bring an extra item for another member
Body: As a group member, I want to mark that I am bringing an extra unit for someone else.

Title: Transfer shared-item responsibility
Body: As a responsible member, I want to transfer an item to another member who accepts it.

Title: Release shared-item responsibility
Body: As a responsible member, I want to state that I can no longer bring an item.

Title: Confirm why an assigned item was not packed
Body: As a responsible member, I must confirm whether I forgot the item, could not bring it, or arranged a replacement.

Title: Warn the group about an uncovered item
Body: As a group member, I want to be notified when required equipment is no longer covered.

Title: Take over a missing shared item
Body: As a group member, I want to take responsibility for a missing item immediately.

Title: View shared-item coverage status
Body: As a group member, I want to see whether each shared item is covered, partially covered, packed, missing, or replaced.

Title: Start a packing session
Body: As an athlete, I want to start preparing for an upcoming activity using my current checklist.

Title: Swipe or tap to confirm an item
Body: As an athlete, I want to mark each item as packed or not packed using swipe gestures or visible buttons.

Title: Confirm a reason for a missing item
Body: As an athlete, I want to provide a reason when an assigned item is not packed.

Title: Receive live missing-item alerts while packing
Body: As an athlete, I want to be notified during packing when another member forgets or releases an item.

Title: Accept responsibility from a live alert
Body: As an athlete, I want to take over a missing item directly from the alert without leaving the packing flow.

Title: See remaining mandatory items
Body: As an athlete, I want to see which mandatory personal items still prevent me from being ready.

Title: Review unresolved group items before finishing
Body: As an athlete, I want to review shared items that remain uncovered before completing the packing session.

Title: Complete a packing session
Body: As an athlete, I want to finish packing after acknowledging any unresolved mandatory issues.

Title: View personal and group readiness
Body: As an athlete, I want to see personal readiness and group readiness separately so that I know whether both I and the team are prepared.
